description: Observable state for a single tracked upload (progress, lifecycle, cancel/resume context) rendered by TmFileUploadProgress.

members.name: BeginAttempt
members.description: Starts a new upload attempt: the previous CTS is cancelled, then disposed when the fresh source replaces it; owns a fresh one and resets the cancel-raised flag. Hosts call this instead of assigning item.Cts. Returns the token of the new attempt. Dismiss still assigns item.Cts = null.

members.name: ResumeAction
members.description: Host (or owning component) action that actually restarts a cancelled or failed upload. Invoked by ResumeAsync before OnResume.

members.name: Dispose
members.description: Cancels an in-flight attempt (so token holders see cancellation, not ObjectDisposedException), then releases the owned CTS so CancellationToken falls back to None.
